-H.Name: -H
-H.description: If the -R option is specified, symbolic links on the command line are followed

-L.Name: -L
-L.description: If the -R option is specified, all symbolic links are followed

-P.Name: -P
-P.description: If the -R option is specified, no symbolic links are followed

-R.Name: -R
-R.description: If source designates a directory, cp copies the directory and the entire subtree connected at that point. If source ends in a /, the contents of the directory are copied rather than the directory itself

-X.Name: -X
-X.description: Do not copy Extended Attributes (EAs) or resource forks

-a.Name: -a
-a.description: Preserves structure and attributes of files but not directory structure

-f.Name: -f
-f.description: If the destination file cannot be opened, remove it and create a new file, without prompting for confirmation

-i.Name: -i
-i.description: Cause cp to write a prompt to the standard error output before copying a file that would overwrite an existing file

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Do not overwrite an existing file

-v.Name: -v
-v.description: Cause cp to be verbose, showing files as they are copied
